items.title: Annie Ross — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I once, with a friend of mine, cooked a goose, which was Julia Childs’s recipe

ctx.x: I like very simple things. I once, with a friend of mine, cooked a goose, which was Julia Childs’s recipe, which was goose stuffed with prunes, which were stuffed with foie gras and prunes. You take the pit out and fill it up with the foie gras and then cook it. My God it was work, but you know something? Worth every hour, every minute of effort. It was delicious.
Did you happen to see the movie Julia, Julia?
